checks_reviewed.analysis_integrity: Executing analyzer and frozen study files are hashed; fit and prediction seals bind ABC/D manifests; D binds complete fits/ABC; release binds fit/prediction/D identities before terminal scoring.
checks_reviewed.data_separation: Geometry, input scaling, block scaling and coefficients use A; B selects penalties/caps; C is diagnostic-only after stored state; D generation follows complete fit seal and forecasts accept queries only.
checks_reviewed.dimension_policy: Native min(cap,d,n_reference-1), with inherited reductions; cap20 duplicates12 at history12; no d-1 constraint introduced.
checks_reviewed.frozen_family: P/G nonlinear, K/P nonlinear, K/R nonlinear at 3% superiority, K/P linear at 5% noninferiority; explicit analyzer/config agreement checks.
checks_reviewed.generator_and_source: Inherited observation-law module validates its pinned generator manifest; local freeze records new and inherited source files; seed derivation checks intended-distinct identities and predecessor exclusions.
checks_reviewed.primary_estimand: Shared cap selected by P on B; arm-specific B penalties; independent-cap view remains secondary. The primary comparison is conditional on this declared P-selected geometry.
checks_reviewed.primary_statistics: 32 independent repetition aggregates; equal horizons and law/noise cells; separate nonlinear and linear panels; four one-sided Bonferroni paired-t upper bounds with df 31; candidate minus factor times comparator; strict upper<0 decision.
checks_reviewed.publication_gate: Production ABC/D preparation requires a receipt bound to exact freeze SHA, verified source flag, repository, branch, commit/tree identities and publication chronology; prepared manifests bind receipt SHA. Offline analyzer/audit also check publication bindings.
checks_reviewed.readout_target: Direct horizon-specific affine ridge predicts the same observed future target; no raw-history baseline, residual target or calibration.
checks_reviewed.scope: Underlying gates are product-simplex coordinates; standardized/radially transformed and enriched readout vectors need not be simplex-valued. No sufficiency, exact closure, rollout utility or general forecasting superiority is established before observing the new results.
checks_reviewed.shared_blocks: At each cap one bank supplies all arms; transformed G is an exact prefix of P, and transformed P an exact prefix of K/R; separate fixed-block radial transforms preserve these identities.

limitations: Read-only source review and inspected artificial receipts cannot guarantee absence of runtime defects or validate unseen production results.
The full production publication/manifest chain is not executed on the two-repetition artificial fixture.
The paired-t analysis is an approximation for independent repetition means; historical precision illustrations do not establish power for the new gate-only comparison.
Fresh repetitions under known laws are new sampling units, not new application domains or an external replication.
remaining_operational_requirements: Freeze the reviewed source, configuration and analysis before any production generation.
Publish and externally verify the frozen commit/tree and record the exact freeze-bound PUBLICATION receipt before ABC preparation.
Complete the fixed 256-task execution, staged seals, terminal analysis and independent production audit regardless of primary outcomes.

reviewer_role: Separate assistant reviewer from implementation and analysis authors; internal review, not external scientific replication
